title: Ryot SmellSafe Hard Shell Krypto-Kit
description:
Ryot SmellSafe Hard Shell Krypto-Kit
This very small Ryot SmellSafe Krypto-Kit looks like it could have been built especially for dynavap vaporizers. With enough room to store both size vapcaps and a lighter. Some lighters may not fit so keep in mind if you have a big bulky lighter.
SmellSafe Tech
One of the special features of the carbon series is that they have activated carbon absorption technology where microscopic charcoal particles are fused together to create an odor protective barrier, blocking unwanted odors from escaping. Combined with our SmellSafe moisture seal zipper, RYOT Pack and Protect has you ready to roll!
Dimensions
Length – 12cm
Width – 6.9cm
Depth – 3.8cm
Included
1 x SmellSafe Hard Shell Krypto-Kit (please choose colour)
1 x Removable Pouch
1 Metal Stoker Tool
